slideshow.notPaired: Not yet paired. Use Menu or Escape key to open Settings.

system.title: System
system.notPairedHint: Not paired yet — see "Pairing" in the left panel.
system.noUsableResult: Update check did not return a usable result.
system.upToDate: Up to date — no update available.
system.fullOsRebootHint: This is a full OS image update — the device will reboot on its own partway through.
system.updateStaged: Update staged — rebooting to apply it.

screens.title: Screens
screens.multiMonitorHint: If a second HDMI display is connected, it mirrors the first automatically — there's no separate setting for it yet.

srtSink.serverDisabled: Turned on here, but disabled fleet-wide from the admin dashboard — contact your church's AnnouncementSlides admin.
srtSink.latencyHint: Lower for less delay on a clean wired network; raise it if the picture stutters.
srtSink.debugOverlayHint: Shows playback stats on top of the video.
srtSink.intro: Receives a live video feed (OBS, vMix, etc.) from your local network over SRT or RIST and plays it full screen.
srtSink.multicastWifiWarning: ⚠ This device is on WiFi. Multicast video over WiFi is not recommended — expect dropouts and stutter. Use a wired Ethernet connection.

revelation.noPeers: Not paired with any Revelation instance yet.
revelation.needsRepair: Needs re-pairing — unpair, then pair again
revelation.noneFound: No Revelation instances found on this network.
revelation.intro: Connects as a peer to Revelation Snapshot Presenter software (snapshots.vrbm.org).

pairing.title: Pairing
pairing.name: Name
pairing.rebootHint: Pairing successful — please reboot the device to complete setup.
pairing.unpairHint: Disconnect from the server and wipe slides without resetting network settings.
pairing.generateHint: Generate a pairing code from your church's Slide Announcer devices page on the AnnouncementSlides website, then enter it below.
pairing.generateHintUrl: On a computer or phone, go to the address below to generate a pairing code, then enter it here.

network.title: Network
network.portalHint: This network needs you to sign in on a web page before it lets the device online. The page opens full screen — use the remote's pointer and keyboard to sign in. You'll be brought back here automatically once you're online (or press Back to return).
network.portalTimeout: Sign-in didn't finish within 10 minutes, so you've been brought back here.

wifiConnect.openNetworkHint: This network is open — no password needed.
wifiConnect.successDetail: Connected to {ssid}, and the internet is reachable.
wifiConnect.limitedDetail: Joined {ssid}, but the internet check says: {connectivity}.

deviceTools.title: Device Restart, Reset & Debugging
deviceTools.restartHint: Reboots the device immediately — the kiosk display will go dark for a bit.
deviceTools.sleepHint: Stops the kiosk and turns off the display, without a full restart — press the remote's power button to wake it back up.
deviceTools.factoryResetHint: Wipes WiFi credentials, pairing, cached slides, and device identity, then reboots — the device comes back up exactly as it would on a brand-new SD card. This cannot be undone. To unpair without wiping WiFi credentials and device identity, use the Pairing tab instead.
deviceTools.keyDebugHint: Shows raw remote-control keypresses on screen, for diagnosing button mappings.

keyDebug.title: Key Debug
keyDebug.hint: Press a button on the remote. Each row is a raw {code} the page received, oldest at the bottom. If a button produces no row at all, the keypress isn't reaching Chromium — check labwc/evdev instead.

advanced.revelationHint: Let a Revelation presenter on your network take over this display for a live presentation.
advanced.srtSinkHint: Receive a live video feed (OBS, vMix, etc.) from your church network over SRT.
advanced.featureOffHint: This feature is turned off — switch it on in Settings > Advanced.

welcome.title: Welcome to Slide Announcer
welcome.intro: Let's get this device ready. It only takes a few minutes.

network.title: Connect to the internet
network.intro: Connect this device to WiFi, or plug in a network cable.

name.title: Name this device
name.intro: Give this device a name that says where it is, like “Fellowship Hall” — or keep the default.
name.label: Device Name or Location
name.paired: This device is paired as “{name}”. You can rename it from the AnnouncementSlides website.

done.slidesNote: The first time, it may take a few minutes for slides to download and appear.
done.unpairedNote: This device isn't paired yet, so it has no slides to show. You can pair it any time from Settings > Pairing — press the Menu button on the remote to open Settings.
done.restartNote: The device will restart once to apply its new name.
